title: CASE 001 — MARA V.
official_record: Official records state Mara Valen was an only child raised at Residence C-17.
discrepancies: Contradictory records recovered from site C-17 mention a sister named Elisa. Physical census logs list two occupants in 2003, but single occupancy in 2004 without death/relocation certificates.

title: ARCHIVE PROTOCOL
official_record: Inspect all evidence carefully before submitting classification. Discrepancies in temporal continuity indicate MANDELA-CLASS INTRUSION events.
discrepancies: Do not attempt to restore deleted local files without authorization.
